Add normalized posterior to boss object

get_normalized_posterior.Rd

Given a boss object with a surrogate log-density function and precomputed essential support, this function estimates the normalization constant (either numerically or via Monte Carlo) and adds a normalized posterior density function as a new attribute in the boss object.

It assumes that boss$essential_support$H is the Hessian of the log-posterior (negative definite at the mode). All internal computations automatically negate it to get the positive-definite precision approximation.

Usage

get_normalized_posterior(
  boss,
  int_method = c("numeric", "mc"),
  nsamples = 10000,
  ...
)

Arguments

boss

A boss object with at least $surrogate (log-density function), $D (dimension), and $essential_support (computed by compute_essential_support()).

int_method

Integration method. One of "numeric" (1D only) or "mc".

nsamples

Number of samples to use for Monte Carlo integration (default 10000).

...

Additional arguments passed to integrate() in numeric mode.

Value

The updated boss object with $normalized_posterior attribute.
